name: Crawl4AI
tagline: Open-source LLM-friendly web crawler and scraper that outputs clean Markdown locally for agents and RAG.
real_test_summary: Tested crawling documentation pages and extracting clean Markdown without boilerplate menus or ads. Integrates smoothly with local LLMs and vector stores.
pros: Produces clean, structured Markdown tailored for local LLM context
Handles dynamic pages via headless browser automation locally
Apache-2.0 license with Python async API and CLI
cons: Rate limits and site blocks still apply when crawling external targets
